stages.rule: All records of the last 24 hours
Loop A only, last 6 hours; nuisance alarms and loop B removed
Stuck or dropped-out sensors flagged (1 found); their readings are excluded from reasoning
Readings at least 4 standard deviations from each rack's own morning baseline
Consecutive deviations of at least 10 minutes merged into episodes
Episodes confirmed by a second signal on the same asset, plus loop context, related events, tickets and procedures
